messages:
sara_sales: Hey team — POC with Acme stalled. Their staging calls are returning 429s intermittently for the last ~10 minutes. They can't complete the regression tests. Need ops/eng help ASAP.

ben_acme: Yep, started at 09:12. We see ~30% of requests failing. No change on our side.

alex_m: pinging eng-ops. @jin_ops can you sanity-check token/quotas? Any rate-limit rules on our side?

jin_ops: looking. I see a short spike on proxy, 429 from inference-service: "rate_limit_exceeded". Rolling logs:
```
2025-11-12T09:14:22Z ERROR request_id=abc123 status=429 model=redwood-phi seq=64 reason=rate_limit_exceeded
2025-11-12T09:14:23Z ERROR request_id=abc124 status=200 model=redwood-phi seq=12
```
Probably batching config spike. Investigating.

marta_eng: Is the customer on dedicated or hosted? That matters for quota rules.

sara_sales: Hosted API — they were using free credits but ramped traffic. Might be hitting default per-second throttles.

jin_ops: Confirmed: their API key is still under free-tier rate_limit=60 rps and they sent a test harness at ~120 rps. I can temporarily bump to 200 rps for their key and monitor. Patching now.

deploy-bot: [deploy] rate_limit-config updated for api_key=acme-poc — rolling config (1/2 nodes) — 09:16 UTC

jin_ops: Patch applied to edge nodes. Can you retry @ben_acme?

ben_acme: Retrying... still seeing some 429s but much lower rate. Tests progressing.

alex_m: Good — timeline? can we keep this until EOD? Sales wants to run full eval.

jin_ops: I'll keep the bump for 4 hours, then automatically scale down. Also creating a temporary rule to track per-key RPS 95th percentile.

marta_eng: Also noticed some long KV cache misses causing higher token compute on first calls; recommend enabling prefix caching for their workload. I can send a config snippet.

sara_sales: Please send snippet + quick how-to. Customer wants to finish by 13:00 PST.

marta_eng: snippet:
```
cache:
  prefix_cache: enabled
  ttl: 3600
  keys: ["/acme/*"]
```
apply via console -> model routes -> caching

ryan_sre: Adding myself in case this becomes broader. Monitoring infra metrics.

jin_ops: FYI created incident ticket INC-20251112-42 and added logs + dashboard link: https://internal/obs/inc/INC-20251112-42

sara_sales: Thanks everyone. Can someone own post-mortem and notes for pricing/limits action items? We need to update the POC checklist.

alex_m: I'll own action items: update docs for default quotas, add a sales-facing note about requesting temporary bumps and expected lead time.

ben_acme: Appreciate the quick response. If you can keep the bump until our tests finish that'd help.

jin_ops: Will do. I'll follow up when we auto-scale it back down.

sara_sales: closing loop — will update customer after they finish. :thumbsup:
